hero.heading: Learning Path
hero.description_1: Follow the lessons in order—complete each chapter to unlock the next.
hero.description_2: Each chapter includes diagrams, real examples, assignments, and a quick quiz.

levels.name: Level I — Genesis
levels.description: Why money breaks down today, what Bitcoin changes, and your first concrete steps—wallets, keys, and using the network with confidence.

levels.name: Level II — Difficulty Adjustment
levels.description: How mining and the difficulty adjustment secure the chain, plus security habits and practical skills you can apply in real situations.

levels.name: Level III — Advanced Sovereignty
levels.description: Deep verification, custody models, and collaborative setups—full control of your rules without having to go it alone.

study_materials.heading: Study Materials
study_materials.description: Download essential Bitcoin resources and books to deepen your understanding:

items.title: Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System (English)
items.author: Satoshi Nakamoto (2008)
items.label: PDF
items.description: The original white paper that started it all. Essential reading for understanding Bitcoin's core design.

items.title: ቢትኮይን፡ ስርዓት ናይ መዘና-ናብ-መዘና ኤሌክትሮኒካዊ ገንዘብ
items.author: ትግርኛ ትርጉም (Pan-African Bitcoin Academy)
items.label: PDF (Tigrigna)
items.description: Tigrigna translation of the Bitcoin whitepaper for Eritrean learners and native Tigrigna readers.

items.title: The Little Bitcoin Book
items.author: Bitcoin Collective (2019)
items.label: Free
items.description: A simple, beginner-friendly introduction to Bitcoin that explains why it matters for sovereignty and self-custody.

items.title: Mastering Bitcoin
items.author: Andreas M. Antonopoulos
items.label: Free (GitHub)
items.description: Comprehensive technical guide to Bitcoin for developers, engineers, and technically-minded individuals.

items.title: The Bitcoin Standard
items.author: Saifedean Ammous (2018)
items.label: Book
items.description: Economic analysis of Bitcoin's origins, monetary properties, and its potential impact on the global economy.

items.title: Bitcoin Africa: Guide to Freedom Money
items.author: African Bitcoiners (2nd Edition)
items.label: Free PDF
items.description: A practical Africa-focused Bitcoin guide covering financial freedom, self-custody, and real-world use.

items.title: Programming Bitcoin
items.author: Jimmy Song (2019)
items.label: Free (GitHub)
items.description: Learn Bitcoin by programming it from scratch. Build Bitcoin libraries in Python step by step.

items.title: Layered Money
items.author: Nik Bhatia (2021)
items.label: Book
items.description: Explains the evolution of money through different layers and why Bitcoin represents a new monetary layer.

items.title: The Little Book of Bitcoin in Tigrigna
items.author: ትግርኛ ትርጉም
items.label: PDF (Tigrigna)
items.description: A simple, beginner-friendly introduction to Bitcoin translated into Tigrigna, explaining why it matters for sovereignty and self-custody.

items.title: Bitcoin Development Philosophy
items.author: Kalle Rosenbaum & Linnéa Rosenbaum
items.label: Free (Online)
items.description: A guide for Bitcoin developers covering decentralization, trustlessness, privacy, scaling, and the philosophy behind Bitcoin's design trade-offs.

items.title: Understanding Bitcoin Scams
items.author: Pan-Africa Bitcoin Academy
items.label: Guide
items.description: Learn to recognize and avoid investment scams, impersonation, phishing, and malware. Essential reading to protect yourself.

items.title: Exonumia Africa
items.author: Localized African Bitcoin learning resources
items.label: Free (Online)
items.description: Explore Bitcoin education resources in multiple African languages and countries.
